title: 第182章  白天晚上都很猛！
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“卧……卧槽！”
“这小子也太牛逼了吧，竟然这么快就将丹方补全了？”
“……”
众人都被眼前这一幕给惊呆了。
强如古焱这等天才炼丹师都还没推演出个所以然，叶长天就直接将丹方补全了。
要不要这么牛逼？
这简直就是把古焱秒杀成了渣渣啊。
“长天弟弟果然一如既往的厉害呢。”
火凤儿见状，嘴角不由勾起一抹惊心动魄的弧度。
旋即……
她目光瞥向古焱，将完整的丹方呈现在古焱面前，淡淡地道：“古焱，我长天弟弟补全的丹方完全正确，所以你输了。”
看着叶长天与完整丹方几乎一字不差的答案，古焱面色难看到了极点。
“这绝对不可能！”
“你们一定是在作弊，肯定是你事先就已经给这小子看过丹方了！”
古焱一脸不可置信地咆哮道。
火凤儿顿时一脸鄙夷地看着古焱：“怎么，你堂堂古家少主，六品巅峰的炼丹天才，输了还要耍赖不成？”
“如果不是作弊，他怎么可能在这么短的时间补全丹方？”
古焱冷冷一笑，目光直直地望向了叶长天：“小子，我再给你半张六品丹方，若是你还能直接将丹方补全，我古焱就心服口服！”
叶长天直接伸出一根手指，淡淡道：“一千万！”
古焱呆了一呆：“什么一千万？”

叶长天笑眯眯地道：“你现在的质疑会对我的名誉造成损失，若是我证明自己没有作弊，你就得赔偿我一千万灵石的名誉损失费！”
他补全丹方，纯靠氪金，花出去的可都是白花花的灵石。
让他花自己的灵石证明自己没有作弊？
想都别想！
虽然他兜里现在拥有的灵石，其实也不是他自己的，但那也不行！
这灵石必须让古焱来出！
顺便再逮着古焱薅一薅！
这家伙背后的古家，可是比火家还要略胜一筹的丹道家族，根本不差钱。
如此肥羊，不宰白不宰！
“……”
古焱嘴角一阵抽搐。
神踏马的名誉损失费！
而且一开口就是一千万灵石！
你特么怎么不去抢？
古焱严重怀疑，这小子纯粹就是狮子大开口，故意吓唬他的。
“好！”
古焱咬了咬牙，目光冰冷地盯着叶长天：“如果你真的作弊了，同样也要赔偿我一千万！”
一千万就一千万！
真当他古焱是吓大的不成？
“没问题。”

叶长天嘴角不由勾起一抹轻微的弧度。
大鱼终于上钩了！
他虽然是真的作弊了，但跟古焱想象中的作弊却是完全不同。
氪金挂逼又岂是古焱明白得了的？
叶长天拿起纸和笔，做好抄录的准备，笑眯眯地看着古焱：“把你的半张丹方说念出来吧。”
古焱也没有废话，开始念出一个个药材名字。
叶长天拿小本本记录下来后，果断地将半张残方丢入了阴阳造化界，然后闭上眼睛装出一副参悟残方的样子。
几分钟后。
叶长天缓缓睁开眼睛，看着古焱淡淡地道：“你这是六品丹药三纹聚神丹的丹方，丹方中缺失的材料一共有七种……”
看着叶长天侃侃而谈地说出丹方缺失的药材，古焱脸色也是变得越发难看起来。
“怎……怎么可能？”
古焱又惊又怒，那望向叶长天的目光中终于浮现出了一抹难以掩饰的惊恐。
三纹聚神丹！
这并非常见的六品丹药，而是他们古家独创的一种丹药，外人是绝对不可能知道三纹聚神丹丹方的！
叶长天根本就不可能有作弊的机会。
也就是说。
叶长天真的在这么短的时间，轻而易举就将三纹聚神丹丹方缺失的材料补全了！
而且还丝毫不差！
这只有两种可能，要么这小子在推演丹方这一块天赋异禀，要么丹道理论知识储备比起七品炼丹师都是有过之而无不及！
无论哪一种情况，都足以证明这小子丹道天赋的恐怖！

该死的！
古焱实在想不明白，火家究竟从什么地方找来了一位如此恐怖的丹道天才？
“古焱，丹方已经补全，现在足以证明我没作弊了吧，你是不是该把一千万灵石的名誉损失给我了？”
就在古焱惊怒不已的时候，叶长天的声音也是直接在他耳边响了起来。
古焱面色难看到了极点。
他很想说叶长天没有补全丹方，可有火丹辰在一旁盯着，以火丹辰的丹道造诣，只需稍加推演就能揭穿他的谎言。
“这是一百万灵石，拿去！”
古焱抬手一挥，直接朝着叶长天丢出一百万灵石，然后带着身旁那位生着一双蛇眼的黑衣中年头也不回地转身离开了。
叶长天身形一闪，直接挡在了古焱的面前，神色也是瞬间冷了下来。
“古焱，一百万就想打发我，你当打发叫花子呢？”
“一千万灵石的名誉损失费，一分都不能少，否则今日你是走不出这青火城的。”
古焱面色铁青地道：“小子，我能拿出一百万灵石，已经算是给你面子，你不要太过分了！”
“看来你是打算赖账了？”
叶长天盯着古焱，眼眸中隐约有青色剑芒闪动着。
古焱冷冷一笑：“是又如何？”
未等古焱话音落下，叶长天抬手轻轻一压，古焱就直接扑通一声跪在了他的面前。
“这个世上，还没人能赖我的账，就算死人都不行！”
叶长天冷冷地瞥了古焱一眼：“十息之内，将一千万灵石一分不少地给我，否则我就先杀了你，再亲自去古家要账！”
“……”
听得叶长天那霸气十足的话语，就连火丹辰都忍不住倒吸一口凉气。

他看着身旁的火凤儿，忍不住暗自抹了把冷汗：“丫头，你男人这么猛你知道吗？”
古家可是比火家还要略甚一筹的丹道家族。
据说还与北寒域的圣级势力北寒圣宗关系极为亲密。
杀了古焱，还要去古家要账？
要不要这么勇？
“知道啊。”
火凤儿笑意吟吟。
她不仅知道叶长天白天猛，而且还知道叶长天晚上也很猛！
“小子，休得伤我家少主！”
就在这时，那位陪同古焱前来火家的蛇眼中年也是反应过来，嘴里不由发出一阵惊怒的爆喝。
炼虚境初期的恐怖气息，也在这一刻轰然爆发开来！
content_en:
"Fuck...fuck!"
"Isn't this guy so awesome? He completed the recipe so quickly?"
"..."
Everyone was stunned by the scene in front of them.
Even a talented alchemist like Gu Yan could not deduce the reason, but Ye Changtian directly completed the recipe.
Do you want to be so awesome?
This simply killed Gu Yan into a scumbag instantly.
"Brother Changtian is indeed as powerful as ever."
When Huo Feng'er saw this, the corner of her mouth couldn't help but curl up in a thrilling arc.
Immediately...
She glanced at Gu Yan, presented the complete prescription in front of Gu Yan, and said calmly: "Gu Yan, the prescription completed by my brother Changtian is completely correct, so you lose."
Seeing the almost word-for-word answers from Ye Changtian and Complete Danfang, Gu Yan looked extremely sad.
"This is absolutely impossible!"
"You must be cheating. You must have shown this boy the recipe beforehand!"
Gu Yan roared with disbelief.
Huo Feng'er immediately looked at Gu Yan with disdain: "Why, you, the majestic young master of the Gu family, a peak-sixth-grade alchemy genius, are you still trying to cheat after losing?"
"If it wasn't cheating, how could he complete the recipe in such a short time?"
Gu Yan smiled coldly and looked straight at Ye Changtian: "Boy, I will give you half a sixth-grade elixir recipe. If you can directly complete the elixir recipe, I, Gu Yan, will be convinced!"
Ye Changtian stretched out a finger and said calmly: "Ten million!"
Gu Yan was stunned for a moment: "What ten million?"
Ye Changtian smiled and said: "Your doubts now will cause damage to my reputation. If I prove that I did not cheat, you will have to compensate me for reputational damage of 10 million spirit stones!"
He relied solely on krypton gold to complete the elixir recipe, and all he spent were white spirit stones.
Let him spend his spiritual stones to prove that he didn't cheat?
Don’t even think about it!
Although the spirit stone he currently has in his pocket is not actually his own, that doesn't work either!
Gu Yan must come out with this spiritual stone!
By the way, I’ll catch Gu Yan and take a bite!
The Gu family behind this guy is the Dandao family that is slightly better than the Huo family, and they are not short of money at all.
Such a fat sheep will not be slaughtered until it is slaughtered!
"..."
The corner of Gu Yan's mouth twitched.
Damn reputational damage!
And as soon as you open your mouth, you get 10 million spiritual stones!
Why the hell don't you go and grab it?
Gu Yan seriously suspected that this kid was just opening his mouth to scare him deliberately.
"Okay!"
Gu Yan gritted his teeth and stared at Ye Changtian with cold eyes: "If you really cheated, you will also have to compensate me 10 million!"
Ten million is ten million!
Do you really think that Gu Yan is so scared?
"No problem."
The corners of Ye Changtian's mouth couldn't help but curve slightly.
The big fish finally took the bait!
Although he really cheated, it was completely different from the cheating Gu Yan imagined.
How can Gu Yan understand the use of money to cheat?
Ye Changtian picked up the paper and pen, prepared to copy, and looked at Gu Yan with a smile: "Read out half of your prescription."
Gu Yan didn't waste any time and started to read out the names of the medicinal materials one by one.
After Ye Changtian recorded it in a small notebook, he decisively threw half of the residual prescription into the world of Yin and Yang, then closed his eyes and pretended to understand the residual prescription.
After a few minutes.
Ye Changtian slowly opened his eyes, looked at Gu Yan and said calmly: "This is the prescription for the sixth-grade elixir, the three-line God-concentrating pill. There are seven missing materials in the prescription..."
Seeing Ye Changtian talk about the missing medicinal materials in the elixir, Gu Yan's face became more and more difficult to look at.
"How...how is it possible?"
Gu Yan was shocked and angry, and an unconcealable panic finally appeared in his eyes looking at Ye Changtian.
Three-line God-gathering Pill!
This is not a common sixth-grade elixir, but a unique elixir created by their ancient family. It is absolutely impossible for outsiders toAnyone who knows the recipe for the Three-Line God-Condensing Pill!
There is no chance for Ye Changtian to cheat.
That is to say.
Ye Changtian really made up for the missing materials in the Three-Line God-Condensing Pill Formula in such a short period of time!
And it’s not bad at all!
There are only two possibilities. Either this kid is extremely talented in deducing alchemy formulas, or his theoretical knowledge of alchemy is even better than that of a seventh-grade alchemist!
No matter which situation, it is enough to prove the terrifying talent of this kid's alchemy!
Damn it!
Gu Yan really couldn't figure out where on earth the Huo family found such a terrifying alchemy genius?
"Gu Yan, the elixir formula has been completed. Now it is enough to prove that I did not cheat. Shouldn't you give me the reputation loss of 10 million spirit stones?"
Just when Gu Yan was shocked and angry, Ye Changtian's voice rang directly in his ears.
Gu Yan's face turned extremely ugly.
He really wanted to say that Ye Changtian didn't complete the elixir recipe, but with Huo Danchen watching from the side, with Huo Danchen's alchemy attainments, he could expose his lies with just a little deduction.
"This is one million spirit stones, take it!"
Gu Yan raised his hand and threw a million spirit stones directly at Ye Changtian, then turned around and left with the middle-aged man in black with a pair of snake eyes beside him without looking back.
Ye Changtian's figure flashed and stood directly in front of Gu Yan, and his expression instantly turned cold.
"Gu Yan, you want to send me away for just one million, how about you treat me like a beggar?"
"The reputation damage fee of 10 million spirit stones must not be less, otherwise you will not be able to leave this Green Fire City today."
Gu Yan's face was ashen and he said: "Boy, I can give you one million spirit stones, which is already considered as giving you face. Don't go too far!"
"It seems you are planning to default on your debt?"
Ye Changtian stared at Gu Yan, with a faint green sword light flashing in his eyes.
Gu Yan smiled coldly: "So what?"
Before Gu Yan could finish his words, Ye Changtian raised his hand and pressed lightly, and Gu Yan knelt down in front of him with a plop.
"No one in this world can rely on me, not even the dead!"
Ye Changtian glanced at Gu Yan coldly: "Give me 10 million spiritual stones in one cent within ten breaths, otherwise I will kill you first and then go to the Gu family to demand the account in person!"
"..."
Hearing Ye Changtian's domineering words, even Huo Danchen couldn't help but take a breath.
He looked at Huo Feng'er beside him and couldn't help but secretly wiped away the cold sweat: "Girl, do you know that your man is so fierce?"
The Gu family is an Alchemy family that is slightly better than the Huo family.
It is said that he also has a very close relationship with the Beihan Holy Sect, a holy force in the Northern Cold Region.
After killing Gu Yan, you still have to go to the Gu family to demand an account?
Do you want to be so brave?
"I know."
Huo Feng'er smiled.
Not only did she know that Ye Changtian was fierce during the day, but she also knew that Ye Changtian was also fierce at night!
"Boy, don't hurt my young master!"
At this moment, the old Snake Eyes who accompanied Gu Yan to Huo's house also reacted and couldn't help but let out a burst of surprise and anger.
The terrifying aura in the early stage of the Void Refining Realm suddenly exploded at this moment!
